summary: P1 Hotfix #3 (Stripe webhook legacy-URL alias) verified. All 8 tests in test_stripe_webhook_route_hotfix3.py pass locally against server.app via TestClient. Live preview URL confirms /api/stripe/webhook now returns HTTP 400 with 'invalid signature: Unable to extract timestamp and signatures from header' (previously 404) and produces a byte-identical response to /api/payments/stripe/webhook. No route shadowing found for /api/stripe/webhook anywhere else in the codebase. Regression check on /api/config/public passes (returns {show_demo_logins: true, app_env: 'preview'}, HTTP 200).
critical_code_review_comments: Alias router pattern is clean and minimal — single forwarding route delegating to the primary handler. No code duplication introduced.
Signature-verification path (stripe.Webhook.construct_event) is shared between both routes, so future changes to secret selection (_select_webhook_secret) apply uniformly.
test_credentials: N/A — webhook signature verification is mocked at stripe.Webhook.construct_event level.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hotfix #3 is locked. If Stripe webhook behavior changes, both /api/stripe/webhook (alias) and /api/payments/stripe/webhook (primary) must be checked. Regression suite is test_stripe_webhook_route_hotfix3.py (8 tests). Phase 41.1d WIP remained in git stash (not touched).
